```{r}
#| label: research-setup
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

db_path <- here("cv-app-test", "cv.db")
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)

publications  <- dbReadTable(con, "publications") |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
  arrange(desc(year))

other_pubs    <- dbReadTable(con, "other_pubs_monos") |>
  arrange(desc(year))

dbDisconnect(con)

# Publication counts by year for timeline
pub_timeline <- publications |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  count(year) |>
  arrange(year)
```

## Publication Activity

```{r}
#| label: pub-timeline
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of peer-reviewed publications by year, 1997–2025"

# Five-year running average for trend line
pub_all_years <- data.frame(
  year = seq(min(pub_timeline$year), max(pub_timeline$year))
) |>
  left_join(pub_timeline, by = "year") |>
  mutate(n = replace(n, is.na(n), 0))

ggplot(pub_all_years, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_col(
    fill  = "#900000",
    alpha = 0.80,
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method  = "loess",
    span    = 0.5,
    se      = FALSE,
    color   = "#555555",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1995, 2026, by = 5),
    expand = c(0.02, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    expand = c(0, 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Publications",
    caption = paste0(
      nrow(publications), " peer-reviewed publications · ",
      "1,109 total citations · h-index 15 (Google Scholar)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x        = element_line(color = "#cccccc"),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "#777777", size = 9),
    plot.caption.position = "plot"
  )
```

## Peer-Reviewed Publications

```{r}
#| label: pub-list
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(publications))) {
  pub <- publications[i, ]

  # Build DOI / link badge
  link_html <- ""
  if (!is.null(pub$doi) && !is.na(pub$doi) && nchar(pub$doi) > 3) {
    link_html <- sprintf(
      ' <a href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#900000;font-weight:600;">DOI →</a>',
      pub$doi
    )
  } else if (!is.null(pub$link_url) && !is.na(pub$link_url) && nchar(pub$link_url) > 5) {
    link_html <- sprintf(
      ' <a href="%s" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#900000;font-weight:600;">Link →</a>',
      pub$link_url
    )
  }

  # Citation count badge
  cite_html <- ""
  if (!is.null(pub$citations) && !is.na(pub$citations) && pub$citations > 0) {
    cite_html <- sprintf(
      '<span style="font-size:0.78rem;background:#fce8e8;color:#900000;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;margin-left:6px;">%d citations</span>',
      as.integer(pub$citations)
    )
  }

  # Journal display
  journal_display <- if (!is.null(pub$journal_name) && !is.na(pub$journal_name) &&
                         nchar(pub$journal_name) > 2) {
    jn <- pub$journal_name
    if (!is.null(pub$vol_issue_pages) && !is.na(pub$vol_issue_pages) &&
        nchar(pub$vol_issue_pages) > 1) {
      paste0(jn, ", ", pub$vol_issue_pages)
    } else {
      jn
    }
  } else {
    pub$journal
  }

  cat('<div class="publication-item">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-year">%s</div>\n',
              ifelse(!is.na(pub$year), pub$year, "")))
  cat('<div class="pub-content">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-title">%s%s</div>\n',
              pub$articleTitle, cite_html))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-authors">%s</div>\n', pub$authors))
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-venue"><em>%s</em></div>\n', journal_display))
  if (nchar(link_html) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf('<div style="margin-top:0.35rem;">%s</div>\n', link_html))
  }
  cat('</div>\n</div>\n\n')
}
```

## Other Publications & Book Chapters

```{r}
#| label: other-pubs
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(other_pubs))) {
  op <- other_pubs[i, ]
  
  cat('<div class="publication-item">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-year">%s</div>\n',
              ifelse(!is.na(op$year), op$year, "")))
  cat('<div class="pub-content">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-title">%s</div>\n', op$title))
  if (!is.na(op$authors) && nchar(op$authors) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-authors">%s</div>\n', op$authors))
  }
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-venue"><em>%s</em></div>\n', op$outlet))
  cat('</div>\n</div>\n\n')
}
```
